llm.summary: This skill is a scoped merchant-shopping assistant that discloses payment and booking risks and requires user consent before purchases or reservations.

dimensions.detail: The skill asks to use existing HTTP/browser tools and optional existing wallet tools only; it explicitly says no filesystem access, environment variables, merchant credentials, wallet setup, card numbers, seeds, passwords, or unrelated files are required.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown documentation plus an MIT-style license, with no executable files, binaries, dependency installation, hooks, or setup scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are tightly scoped to KnifeRevive URLs, documented API endpoints, itemized quotes, consent references, and verified payment or booking status; they also prohibit following product-data instructions, unsolicited pitches, forged approval, and automatic retries that could double-charge.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No cross-session persistence, background worker, memory writing, tool modification, or privilege escalation is present; session tokens are described as private, merchant-scoped, and two-hour limited.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill can help compare KnifeRevive products and Bay Area sharpening services, create quotes, and prepare checkout or booking handoffs; that spending-related capability is high impact but coherent with the stated storefront purpose and repeatedly gated on explicit customer consent.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill can help prepare real purchases, prepaid sharpening bookings, and Lightning or hosted-checkout payment handoffs. Only approve checkout when the itemized quote, merchant, fulfillment details, total, and payment rail match what you want; do not provide card numbers, passwords, wallet seeds, or merchant secrets in chat.
llm.findings: [EA3] expected: The advisory finding points to standard MIT license language granting software redistribution rights, not to runtime instructions giving the agent unrelated authority; artifact instructions remain scoped to the storefront workflow.

clawscan.summary: This is a narrowly scoped KnifeRevive shopping and sharpening concierge skill with clear consent, payment, token, and wallet limits.
